sections.en: 3 Διὸς ('of Zeus') corrected by Kroll : ζῳδίου ('of the zodiac sign') the codex has. 4 δισσωμένοις ('being doubled') the codex has. 5 ἐπικουρίοις ('auxiliary') the codex has. 12 We have edited from codices A(ngelicus) and M(ediolanensis). 14 τυχόντες ('happening') A : τύχωσιν ('they might happen') M. 17 αὐτοῦ ('of him/it') as it seems M. 19 ἀνοειδές ('formless') M. συλλαγῶν ('of collections') A. 20 καὶ ('and') bracketed. 22 τῆς Σελ. ('of the Moon') I have inserted. 22-23 μαρτυροῦσι ('they bear witness') M. 24 πραγμάτων ἡ ἑρμηνεία ('the interpretation of matters') M. λήψεως ('of taking') A : πόσεως ('of drinking') A. Or perhaps πίστεως ('of faith')? 25 μαρτυροῦσιν ('they bear witness') (σης ('-ses') written above) M. 30 The first words are corrupt : ἐν ἑπτὰ χροιαὶ καθεστήκασιν γενεαῖς ('in seven colors they have been established for generations') (for γένεσι ('kinds')?) or something of the sort. 31 εὐχροίᾳ ('good complexion')] Or perhaps ὠχρᾷ ('pale')? or σιτοχρόῳ ('wheat-colored'), cf. below v. 181, 19?

summary.headline: Partnerships and Planetary Colors
summary.text: Astrological rules for marriage separation and reconciliation, partnerships, transactions, inheritances, military service, business, interpretation, and other activities according to planetary witnesses and sign types. A following section classifies each star by its colors and smell, listing white, black, red, yellow, greenish, good-colored, and bluish.
